name: APA Corporation
reason: Oil and gas E&P whose earnings are set by commodity prices (EPS swung from -1.13 to 7.68 over the decade).

name: Eastman Chemical Company
reason: Chemicals maker with cyclical, feedstock-driven earnings: 10y EPS CAGR -2.9%, margin at 18th percentile and net debt/EBITDA 3.0x.

name: Mercury General Corporation
